SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.sku
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.quantity > 0
  AND p.product_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.sku
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
